name: mp3val
desc: Program for MPEG audio stream validation
why: Validating MPEG audio stream structure exposes the frame-level innards of MP3 files, a close call for a file-format dissection tool.

brief.what_it_is: MP3val is a free software tool for checking the integrity of MPEG audio files, mainly MP3 (MPEG 1 Layer III). It takes MPEG audio files as input and reports whether they are valid. The homepage says it can also fix most of the problems it finds. The core is a command-line program, with two separate graphical frontends: a native Windows one and a Python GTK script. The homepage says it knows the common tag types (ID3v1, ID3v2, APEv2) and supports other MPEG versions and layers. The exact report format and fix behaviour are not described on the homepage.
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage says it is useful for finding corrupted MPEG audio files, such as ones that were incompletely downloaded, truncated, or contain garbage, and for repairing them.
brief.install_notes: Binaries for Windows are offered (MP3val 0.1.8, with frontend 0.1.1 included), and source for the command-line tool is offered as platform-independent source, about 20 Kb. The homepage says it runs on Windows and on Linux or BSD. The Python GTK frontend (mp3valgui) requires Python, PyGTK and GTK+, and the homepage says installing it on Windows is 'a bit tricky', so the Windows native frontend is recommended there. No brew-specific notes were in the homepage. The brew formula and caveats were not checked.
brief.standout: Its validation looks inside the frame-level structure of MP3 files, not just checking headers or file length. It also tries to repair problems rather than only reporting them. The homepage calls it 'small, high-speed'.
brief.status: Quiet, by inference only. The homepage shows the current release as 0.1.8 but gives no release date. The copyright notice reads 2005-2007, and the frontends are dated 2007. No README or commit history was checked, so this is a weak signal.
brief.caveats: The homepage shows no dates for the latest release, so age is inferred from 2005-2007 copyright notices and 2007 frontend versions. The GUI frontends are old and have platform limits: the Windows one is native, and the Python one is hard to install on Windows. Licensing is GPL v2 or later for the software, while the site text is CC BY-SA 3.0. The homepage's documentation and screenshots links were not followed, so no command-line usage was seen.
quotes: A free software tool to validate and fix MPEG audio files
MP3val is a small, high-speed, free software tool for checking MPEG audio files' integrity.
It can be useful for finding corrupted files (e.g. incompletely downloaded, truncated, containing garbage).
